subject: Trainee / Junior Irrigation Designer application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Cadsult team,

I'm applying for the Trainee / Junior Irrigation Designer role in Perth, advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reviewing drawings and doing site inspections and quality checks. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I'm open to discussing a move to Perth.

Your advert offers mentoring toward the Certified Irrigation Designer qualification, and I'd like to build on my drainage design work that way. I haven't designed irrigation systems yet, and my AutoCAD work so far is from study.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Cadsult was founded in 1993 as a one-person design company and now works from Perth, Melbourne and Sydney, with over 1000 landscape projects including more than 140 schools.
letter.subject: Application for Trainee / Junior Irrigation Designer, Perth
paragraphs: I am applying for the Trainee / Junior Irrigation Designer role with your Perth team, advertised on SEEK. You are offering to train the right person toward the Certified Irrigation Designer qualification, and that kind of start in water management design is what I am looking for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. In that course I designed and documented stormwater drainage, earthworks, road geometry and pavement systems, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against project requirements, carried out site inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and material records.

Cadsult has grown from a one-person design company in 1993 to offices in Perth, Melbourne and Sydney, with more than 140 school projects among its landscape work. I have not designed irrigation systems yet and my AutoCAD experience is from study, so I would be learning the irrigation side from your team. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and am open to discussing relocation to Perth.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
